report_identity.report_title: San Miguel Brewery Hong Kong Ltd. Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and distributes bottled, canned and draught beers through Hong Kong and Mainland China operations, with international sales also reported by customer geography.

segments.business_substance: Manufacture and distribution of own brewed beer products and distribution of imported beer products in Hong Kong and overseas.
Manufacture and distribution of own brewed beer products in southern Mainland China and overseas.

business_overview.revenue_model: Beer product sales are recognized when goods are delivered to customer premises, picked up by customers, shipped on board or transported to the agreed destination.
business_notes: All revenue is generated from manufacture and distribution of bottled, canned and draught beers.
Largest customer contributed HKD 406.090m, 55% of 2023 revenue.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Tax credit increased 2023 net profit and should not be treated as normal operating cash earnings.
No 2023 subsidy; 2022 comparative was HKD 6.168m under Employment Support Scheme.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Cash conversion was positive in all three years but 2023 was much stronger than 2021-2022 and benefited from working-capital release. 2023 net profit also includes a large tax credit, so owner-earnback denominator should be discounted.

gaps: The annual report does not disclose full parent/subsidiary cash split beyond Mainland China cash.
No disclosed minimum operating cash requirement; owner-earnback analysis estimates it separately.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; PPE purchase cash flow is used as conservative capex reference.
